main_text.p: opera quibus cælum mercari & mereri dicamur, accepimus à Deo. Hæc ille, ubi agitur de Me-rito de Condigno, secundùm justitiæ æquali-tatem. In qua similitudine, qui ex pecunia emptoris sibi à venditore gratis datâ proprie dictum Meritum de Condigno elicere conabi-tur, cur non febricitantis insomnium somni-âsse existimetur, equidem non video.

Altera erit conclusio Jesuitæ {*}Vasquezii:In 1. 2. Tom. 2. disp. 214. cap. 5. num. 16. Is qui æquum promittit (inquit) pro pecunia exi-gi valeris, non[?] propterea auget pretium & valorem pecuniæ, pro qua illum est pollicitus: sed eodem modo excederet illud, quod ex promisso daretur, illud minimum pretium, ac si pactum nullum intercessisset. Et propterea excessus illius rei, quæ redditur ex promissione pro parvo pretio, potiùs donatio judicatur, quàm pretii compensatio & venditio. Sic ille. Qua confessione Pontificiorum munimentum maximum Meriti de Condigno, quod pactum dicitur, dejectum corruit. Qui in his similitudinibus causæ nostræ firmamentum non videt, nihil illi aliud dicam, quàm illud proverbiale, [illegible, ~10 letters]. Sed majora molimur.

page.notes: Greek proverb at the end of the second paragraph is not legible from the scan. "non" is read as "non" but could be "nam"; "valeris" and "exi-gi" are as printed but uncertain. Running head printed as ANTIDOTVM, transcribed with u per convention. "Cap.16." beside the running head is a chapter number and is not included in running_head. Faint show-through text in the lower half and right edge is ignored. A reference mark "*" is printed before "Vasquezii" and its note sits in the left margin.
